Event classification code. One of IC, WWD, STPV, TV, LCV, RLV, NM-VV, NM-VRU, CRSH. Confirmed expansions: WWD = wrong-way driving, RLV = red light violation, NM-VV = near miss between two vehicles, NM-VRU = near miss between a vehicle and a vulnerable road user, CRSH = crash, IC = illegal crossing. STPV, TV and LCV are inferred as stopped vehicle, turn violation and lane change violation respectively and are NOT yet confirmed with Derq.

Classification of the second object involved. Null for single-object events such as a stopped vehicle.
